description: Overnight, checks each client’s Xero file against the mySMB checks catalogue, wherever the entries came from: fraud and duplicate checks daily (changed supplier bank details, duplicate bills and invoices, spend money that matches a bill, new suppliers paid fast), the rest weekly (GST, attachments over $82.50, unreconciled and unsent items, suspense balances, lock dates, journals, GST registration). Keeps one Checks item per client in WorkQ, rewritten each run with what is open; tick a line or use the Check findings form to dismiss or snooze one. Publishes a weekly data quality report. Reads only: nothing is changed in Xero. Run by hand with a client’s name to check it now.

# ── bookkeeping kit: shared helpers (inlined into each node by gen-ext.js) ── import json import re import datetime import hashlib from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo # Knowledge layout. Folders may nest at most 2 levels, so inbox folders are top-level. BK_SETTINGS = "Bookkeeping/settings.json" BK_CLIENTS = "Bookkeeping/Clients" BK_RULES = "Bookkeeping/Rules" BK_BILLS = "Bookkeeping/Bills" BK_INBOX = "Bookkeeping Inbox" BK_PROCESSED = "Bookkeeping Processed" BK_FAILED = "Bookkeeping Failed" BK_MAIL = "Bookkeeping/Mail" BK_REQUESTS = "Bookkeeping Requests" BK_CHECKS = "Bookkeeping/Checks" # One threshold for "needs a tax invoice / an ABN / an attachment": $75 excluding GST = $82.50 including GST. BK_GST_INVOICE_LIMIT = 82.5 def bk_read_json(path, default=None): try: raw = api.files.read(file=path) except Exception: return default try: return json.loads(raw) except Exception: return default def bk_write_json(path, data): api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True)) def bk_fmt(amount, currency=""): if amount is None: return "—" return (currency + " " if currency else "") + "{:,.2f}".format(amount) def bk_tz(settings): # The sandbox may lack the tz database; fall back to AEST (UTC+10) rather than failing the run. try: return ZoneInfo((settings or {}).get("timezone") or "Australia/Sydney") except Exception: return datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=10)) def bk_today(settings): return datetime.datetime.now(bk_tz(settings)).date() # ── bookkeeping kit: ledger checks (inlined into the Ledger checks nodes by gen-ext.js) ── # The rules are ledger-neutral. They read the snapshot a ledger adapter builds (xero_ledger for Xero), so a # Bookkeeping for MYOB or QuickBooks pack only needs its own adapter: # contacts [{id, name, tax_number (digits), bank (digits; never stored), has_address, link}] # docs [{id, kind: bill|invoice|bill_credit|invoice_credit, number, contact_id, contact, date, due, # status: draft|submitted|authorised|paid|void, total, tax, due_amount, paid_on, attachments, sent, # lines: [{account, tax_type, amount (ex GST), tax}], link}] # bank [{id, kind: spend|receive|other (transfers, prepayments), contact_id, contact, date, total, tax, attachments, reconciled, lines, link}] # weekly only: accounts [{id, code, name, type, tax_type, active, pl}], tax_rates {tax_type: rate %}, # journals [{id, date, narration, link}], org {lock_date, eoy_lock_date, settings_link}, # balances {now, month_ago: {account id: balance}}, pl_12m {income, moved: [account ids]} # IDs, names and default severities are the mySMB checks catalogue's (Prompt Library, Checks sheet). Urgent is # never set automatically. Readings marked heuristic wait on the content owner's confirmation. import secrets CK_CATALOGUE = { "CHK-006": ("Contacts", "Duplicate Contact", "Medium"), "CHK-007": ("Contacts", "TPAR Information Missing", "Medium"), "CHK-008": ("Contacts", "Large GST Activity for Contact Without ABN", "Medium"), "CHK-017": ("Banking", "Contact Bank Account Changed", "High"), "CHK-018": ("Banking", "Contact Bank Account Same as Existing Supplier", "Low"), "CHK-021": ("Banking", "Expenses in (Month) Without Attachments Over $75", "Low"), "CHK-022": ("Banking", "Unreconciled Transactions Last Month", "Low"), "CHK-024": ("Sales", "Invoice Not Sent to Contact", "Low"), "CHK-028": ("Sales", "Possible Duplicate Customer Invoice", "Medium"), "CHK-031": ("Sales", "GST on Invoice and/or Credit Note When Not Registered", "Medium"), "CHK-033": ("Sales", "Invoices in Draft or Awaiting Approval", "Low"), "CHK-035": ("Sales", "Duplicate Invoice Paid", "Medium"), "CHK-055": ("Purchases", "Possible Duplicate Bill", "Medium"), "CHK-056": ("Purchases", "Unusual New-Supplier Payment Pattern", "Low"), "CHK-057": ("Purchases", "Supplier Bank Details Changed Before A Payment", "High"), "CHK-058": ("Purchases", "GST Claimed on a Non-Claimable Item", "Medium"), "CHK-059": ("Purchases", "Transaction With a GST Inconsistency", "Medium"), "CHK-079": ("Purchases", "Duplicate Bill Raised", "Medium"), "CHK-080": ("Purchases", "Duplicate Bill Paid", "Medium"), "CHK-086": ("Purchases", "Bills Raised Without Attachments Over $75", "Low"), "CHK-087": ("Purchases", "Spend Money Transaction with Like or Similar Bill", "Low"), "CHK-125": ("Bookkeeping", "Suspense or Uncoded Account With an Aged Balance", "Medium"), "CHK-129": ("Bookkeeping", "GST Account Has No GST Against It", "Medium"), "CHK-132": ("Bookkeeping", "Accounting System Getting Lonely", "Low"), "CHK-133": ("Bookkeeping", "Month-End Journals Missing", "Medium"), "CHK-134": ("Bookkeeping", "Lock Date Not Set", "Medium"), "CHK-135": ("Bookkeeping", "Lock Date Change", "Medium"), "CHK-136": ("Bookkeeping", "GST Registration Required", "Medium"), "CHK-138": ("Bookkeeping", "Inactive Account", "Low"), } # Cadence (extension owner, 14 Oct 2026): fraud and duplicate checks daily, the rest weekly. CK_DAILY = ("CHK-006", "CHK-017", "CHK-018", "CHK-028", "CHK-035", "CHK-055", "CHK-056", "CHK-057", "CHK-079", "CHK-080", "CHK-087") CK_WEEKLY = ("CHK-007", "CHK-008", "CHK-021", "CHK-022", "CHK-024", "CHK-031", "CHK-033", "CHK-058", "CHK-059", "CHK-086", "CHK-125", "CHK-129", "CHK-132", "CHK-133", "CHK-134", "CHK-135", "CHK-136", "CHK-138") CK_HEURISTIC = ("CHK-056", "CHK-129", "CHK-133") # Findings the client has to answer (receipts, ABNs, TPAR details): the Client Queries part of the weekly report. CK_CLIENT_QUERY = ("CHK-007", "CHK-008", "CHK-021", "CHK-086") CK_CATEGORIES = ("Contacts", "Banking", "Sales", "Purchases", "Bookkeeping") CK_SEVERITY_RANK = {"High": 0, "Medium": 1, "Low": 2} CK_PRIORITY = {"High": "high", "Medium": "medium", "Low": "low"} CK_DAILY_DAYS = 35 CK_DUP_DAYS = 7 CK_NEW_SUPPLIER_DAYS = 30 CK_NEW_SUPPLIER_LARGE = 5000.0 CK_QUICK_PAY_DAYS = 2 CK_BANK_CHANGE_DAYS = 30 CK_DUE_SOON_DAYS = 14 CK_LONELY_DAYS = 30 CK_GST_TURNOVER = 75000.0 CK_LOCK_MONTHS = 6 CK_MAX_LINES = 60 # Patterns are plain strings, used with re.search and re.sub: the Publish lint rejects compiling them. CK_NON_CLAIMABLE = (r"(?i)\b(wages?|salar(y|ies)|superannuation|super|payg|bank (fees?|charges?)|interest|" r"depreciation|amortis\w*|asic|stamp duty|fines?|penalt\w*|donations?|land tax|" r"income tax|fbt|drawings|dividends?)\b") CK_SUSPENSE = r"(?i)\b(suspense|clearing|uncoded|unallocated|holding)\b" CK_MONTHS = r"(?i)\b(jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|sept|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*\b" # ── Contacts and banking (daily) ── # ── Duplicates, payments and new suppliers (daily) ── # ── GST, attachments, sales and housekeeping (weekly) ── # ── The findings file and the client's checklist ── # ── The client's Checks item in WorkQ: one open item per client, found by the id kept in its findings file ── def ck_day(value): try: return datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(value)[:10]) except Exception: return None def ck_date_text(value): d = ck_day(value) return d.strftime("%d %b %Y").lstrip("0") if d else "no date" def ck_ref(key): """The short code printed on a finding's line, so a tick or the Check findings form can point at it.""" return hashlib.sha256(str(key).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:6].upper() def ck_open(state): rows = [f for f in (state.get("findings") or {}).values() if f.get("status") == "open"] rows.sort(key=lambda f: (CK_CATEGORIES.index(f["category"]) if f["category"] in CK_CATEGORIES else 9, CK_SEVERITY_RANK.get(f["severity"], 9), -(f.get("amount") or 0), f["key"])) return rows # ── Publish the weekly report ── import html as _html summary = params.get("summary") or {} report_url = "" if not params.get("problem") and summary.get("report_due"): settings = bk_read_json(BK_SETTINGS) or {} today = bk_today(settings) clients = [] for f in api.files.list(path=BK_CLIENTS): c = bk_read_json(f["path"]) if str(f.get("name") or "").endswith(".json") else None if c and c.get("xero_tenant_id") and c.get("checks_enabled", True) is not False: state = bk_read_json(BK_CHECKS + "/" + c["slug"] + ".json") or {} clients.append((c, state, ck_open(state))) clients.sort(key=lambda t: str(t[0].get("name") or "").lower()) def esc(value): return _html.escape(str(value if value is not None else "")) def money(value): return bk_fmt(value) if value is not None else "—" def finding_row(name, f): link = (" Open in Xero") if f.get("link") else "" return ("" + esc(name) + "" + esc(f["severity"]) + "" + esc(f["check"]) + " " + esc(f["name"]) + "" + money(f.get("amount")) + "" + esc(f["text"]) + link + "" + esc(ck_ref(f["key"])) + "") summary_rows, query_rows, open_rows = [], [], [] for c, state, rows in clients: quiet = len([f for f in (state.get("findings") or {}).values() if f.get("status") in ("dismissed", "snoozed")]) count = {s: len([f for f in rows if f["severity"] == s]) for s in ("High", "Medium", "Low")} summary_rows.append("" + esc(c.get("name")) + "" + str(count["High"] or "—") + "" + str(count["Medium"] or "—") + "" + str(count["Low"] or "—") + "" + money(sum(f.get("amount") or 0 for f in rows) if rows else None) + "" + str(quiet or "—") + "" + esc(state.get("last_daily") or "not yet") + "") for f in rows: (query_rows if f["check"] in CK_CLIENT_QUERY else open_rows).append(finding_row(c.get("name"), f)) head = "BusinessSeverityCheck$FindingRef" page = ( "Ledger checks " + str(today) + "" "" "

Data quality: ledger checks, " + ck_date_text(today) + "

" "

Open findings from the Ledger checks automation as of its last run for each business (not live). " "Severities are the checks catalogue's defaults. Dismissed and snoozed findings aren't listed.

" "

By business

" "" + ("".join(summary_rows) or "") + "
BusinessHighMediumLow$ at riskDismissed or snoozedLast checked
No businesses have ledger checks turned on.
" "

Client queries

Findings the business has to answer: receipts, ABNs and TPAR details.

" "" + head + "" + ("".join(query_rows) or "") + "
None.
" "

Everything else

" + head + "" + ("".join(open_rows) or "") + "
None.
" "

Generated by Bookkeeping for Xero.

" ) saved = api.artifacts.put(title="Ledger checks " + str(today), content=page, file_name="ledger-checks-" + str(today) + ".html", kind="document", mime_type="text/html", tags=["bookkeeping", "checks", "data-quality"]) report_url = (saved or {}).get("url") or "" bk_write_json(BK_CHECKS + "/_report.json", {"on": str(today), "url": report_url}) recipients = [x for x in {settings.get("checks_owner_id") or settings.get("reviewer_id")} if x] if recipients: high = sum(len([f for f in rows if f["severity"] == "High"]) for _c, _s, rows in clients) total = sum(len(rows) for _c, _s, rows in clients) api.notify.send(title="Weekly ledger checks report is ready", body=(str(total) + " open finding(s), " + str(high) + " high. " + report_url).strip(), user_ids=recipients)
